data.body_html:
Planning a marbella sunset cruise romantic dinner menu ideas is the key to an unforgettable evening on the Mediterranean. Whether you’re proposing, celebrating an anniversary, or simply spoiling your partner, the combination of a private boat, golden hour views, and a thoughtfully curated menu transforms a standard dinner into a five-star experience. Departing from Puerto Banús, our fleet offers intimate spaces for two or spacious decks for a group, all with a licensed skipper and included drinks. This guide covers menu inspiration, boat choices, and practical tips to make your sunset dinner seamless and romantic.

Why Choose a Marbella Sunset Cruise for a Romantic Dinner?

Marbella’s coastline offers a unique dining backdrop: the Sierra Blanca mountains turn pink, the sea glows amber, and the only sounds are the lapping waves and distant seagulls. A private charter lets you escape crowded restaurants and enjoy a bespoke meal at your own pace. The average summer temperature of 22°C at sunset means al fresco dining is comfortable from May to October. Plus, with the boat anchored off the Golden Mile or near Cala Cortés, you get uninterrupted views of the Costa del Sol’s most exclusive shoreline.

Romantic Dinner Menu Ideas for Your Sunset Cruise

When designing your marbella sunset cruise romantic dinner menu ideas, think light, fresh, and easy to eat on deck. Here are three curated menus that pair perfectly with our included drinks (cava, white wine, beer, soft drinks) or upgraded champagne.

Menu 1: Spanish Tapas & Cava

  • Start: Jamón ibérico de bellota, manchego cheese with quince paste, marinated olives.
  • Main: Gambas al ajillo (garlic prawns), patatas bravas with spicy sauce, and grilled piquillo peppers.
  • Dessert: Crema catalana or fresh figs with honey.
  • Pair with: Chilled cava or a crisp albariño from Rías Baixas.

Menu 2: Seafood Platter & Rosé

  • Start: Oysters, tiger prawns, and lobster tail with lemon and aioli.
  • Main: Grilled sea bass or dorada with roasted vegetables and a side of salsa verde.
  • Dessert: Lemon sorbet with vodka shot.
  • Pair with: A dry rosé from Navarra or a buttery chardonnay.

Menu 3: Italian Inspired & Prosecco

  • Start: Bruschetta with tomato and basil, buffalo mozzarella with pesto.
  • Main: Truffle risotto or lobster linguine.
  • Dessert: Tiramisu or panna cotta with berry coulis.
  • Pair with: Prosecco or a light pinot grigio.

All menus can be pre-ordered from local Marbella caterers or prepared by a private chef (available on request). We recommend ordering 48 hours in advance.

Which Boat Suits Your Romantic Dinner?

Our fleet departs from Puerto Banús, so you’re steps away from Marbella’s finest delis and restaurants. For a cosy dinner for two, the Azimut 39 (11 pax) or Astondoa 40 (9 pax) are ideal – both offer a comfortable saloon and aft deck for dining. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours. If you’re celebrating with friends or family, the Mangusta 80 (12 pax) provides a spacious flybridge and jet ski for pre-dinner fun, from €4,719 for 4 hours. For larger groups, the Ferretti 94 (12 pax) or Canados 86 (12 pax) offer opulent interiors. Browse our full fleet for more options.

How to Arrange Your Romantic Dinner on Board

Our standard charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. For a full romantic dinner, you have two options:

  1. Bring your own catering – Order from a Marbella restaurant or deli (e.g., tapas boxes, sushi platters) and have it delivered to the boat before departure.
  2. Private chef – We can arrange a chef to prepare a bespoke menu on board. This is popular for proposals. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing (not included in standard rates).

The skipper will anchor at a scenic spot like Cala del Faro or off the Marbella Club Hotel, and set up a table on deck or in the saloon. Candles, flowers, and music can be arranged – just let us know.

Sample Sunset Cruise Itinerary

Here’s how a typical 3-hour romantic sunset dinner might unfold:

  • 18:00 – Board your boat at Puerto Banús. Meet the skipper and settle in with a glass of cava.
  • 18:15 – Depart the marina, heading west towards Cabopino or east towards Cala Cortés.
  • 18:30 – Anchor at a quiet cove. Start your first course as the sun begins to dip.
  • 19:15 – Main course served while the sky turns gold and pink.
  • 20:00 – Dessert and champagne as the stars appear.
  • 20:30 – Return to Puerto Banús, with views of the illuminated marina.

This timing works perfectly from May to September. In spring or autumn, adjust departure to 17:00 for the best light.

Tips for a Perfect Romantic Sunset Dinner

  • Book early – sunset slots are popular, especially in July and August.
  • Dress in layers – evenings can be breezy on the water.
  • Choose easy-to-eat dishes – avoid heavy sauces or messy foods.
  • Bring a camera – the sunset over La Concha is Instagram-worthy.
  • Consider a proposal – many guests choose this setting for a ring. We can help with flowers and champagne.

For more inspiration, read our guide on marbella sunset cruise romantic dinner menu ideas or check our boat rental page for availability.
